changeinfo.changes:
『Ragnarok Odyssey ACE』
Ver. 1.31


The following issues have been fixed:
  • The error regarding the Emperium Shard has been fixed.
  • The problem regarding the incorrect number of Prismatic Dust dropped after defeating the Domovoi Ranger has been fixed.
  • The error in the different version of “Cancel Lock on” for control type 2 and 4 from the previous version has been fixed.
  • The error in the input function of the controller button after specific procedures during game play for PlayStation®Vita TV system has been fixed.
  • The error in the action control for the “Communication” function has been fixed.
  • Other errors have been fixed.

『Ragnarok Odyssey ACE』
Ver 1.30


This update contains the following features and improvements:
  • Addition of a new stage, Prison of the Gods
  • Addition of new quests
  • Addition of new weapons
  • Addition of new outfits
  • Addition of new ACE skills
  • Addition of Online Services features
    • Expansion on Norn Exchange features
    • Expansion on Quest Counter features
    • Being able to buy Emperium Shards from Norn Exchange.
  • Change in display for My Orders
  • Addition of new features for BGM Select
  • Addition of new DLC data
  • Cross-play with the PlayStation®3 system version of Ragnarok Odyssey ACE
  • Cross-save with the PlayStation®3 system version of Ragnarok Odyssey ACE
  • Compatible with PlayStation®Vita TV system
  • The drop amount of Prismatic Dust after defeating a Domovoi Ranger has been adjusted
The following issues have been fixed:
  • a bug that the dragon-type monsters drop inappropriate materials when their specific body parts are destroyed
  • a but that does not sync "Complete card collection" trophy info after importing the data from the original Ragnarok Odyssey's backup data
  • a bug that overwrites the accepted "Made-to-Order" with a different order
  • various issues in the Mercenary Book
  • various other issues.

『Ragnarok Odyssey ACE』
Ver. 1.02


This update contains the following bug fix:
  • A fix for an issue that causes the cost of some extracted cards to become higher than they should be when the data is transferred from "Ragnarok Odyssey".
    *This fix will be applied automatically to the already transferred data as you load the relevant save data.

『Ragnarok Odyssey ACE』
Ver. 1.01


This update contains the following features and improvements:
  • Additional downloadable contents
  • Additional hairstyle and face types
  • Corrections of some defects
